description: AgentServices is a hosted API platform for AI agents that offers crypto market data, web research, on-chain analytics, inference, and ERC-8004 identity/reputation endpoints. It also publishes a remote MCP server for connecting those capabilities to MCP-compatible clients.
summary: AgentServices exposes a public REST API at https://agentservices.to and a streamable-HTTP MCP server at https://agentservices.to/mcp; docs advertise x402 wallet micropayments for paid REST routes and OAuth metadata for MCP connectors, but both surfaced endpoints are documented as reachable without pre-minted service credentials.
